subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message channel activity through existing system-event/inbound-runner APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or adapter contract?
rationale: The current code exposes partial primitives, but choosing a public Plugin SDK event surface affects third-party compatibility and overlaps with an open inbound_activity hook proposal.

options.title: Document Current System Event Path
options.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the channel-plugin recipe, and add only the smallest code seam if that recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Event Hook
options.body: Define a typed Plugin SDK hook or channel adapter for non-message inbound activity and coordinate it with the related inbound_activity PR before merge.

options.title: Wait For Plugin Proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why system events and runChannelInboundEvent cannot support the use case.

recommendation.title: Document Current System Event Path
recommendation.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the channel-plugin recipe, and add only the smallest code seam if that recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent path history across the Plugin SDK docs/core and likely owns the API direction choice best among the available routing candidates.
